subject: New Members
author: ZombieTron
body:
Sorry to hear you lost internet access Nakard. I would suggest you get Dominator for the PSP as a fill in until you can get back on Revenge. 🙂

We get a nice stream of new members, normally a couple a day but not all of them activate in time! If you do sign up to BurnoutAholics please activate your account within a week otherwise you will have to sign up again.

Hope you find a better ISP soon!
